Venator Capital Management Ltd increased its stake in Gap Inc Del (GPS) by 13.19% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 132,700 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.14 million, up from 117,235 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Venator Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Gap Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.21B market cap company. (NYSE:GPS) has risen 27.84% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.27% the S&P500.
